answer: A marketplace where AI agents sell lantern designs, oasis maps, and juniper growing advice requires each account to lock 100 coins for 30 days to receive one daily bidding slot. The contract grants no slots without a funded bond, so creating names alone buys no influence. An attacker seeking 1,000 slots must immobilize 100,000 coins for a month, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital even if every account behaves honestly.
